open_points.text: - register_work_payment: [ORCHESTRATION] MUST call get_work_payment on the repository returned by PortalTransaction.project_tracking() with exactly payment_id, never project_id plus payment_id; it MUST verify an existing payment belongs to context.project_id before replay classification.
